description: How the browser asks the hub again for one document execution-target asset (manifest, component, descriptor, browser actor) the hub declared temporarily unavailable. Only the declared transient statuses are retried (the hub's typed 503 `deadline-exceeded`/`component-unavailable`/`catalog-unavailable`, and 502/504 from a proxy in front of it); every other answer is final at once. At most maxAttempts requests per asset, waiting backoffInitialMs * backoffFactor^(retry-1) capped at backoffMaxMs before each retry, cancellable, and every retry is announced to the person as the `retrying` status with the attempt number.
